blocks.text: Savolda so'z tartibi: yordamchi fe'l egadan oldin

O'zbek tilida savol yasash oson: darak gapning oxiriga **-mi** qo'shiladi, so'z tartibi o'zgarmaydi: U uyda. → U uyda**mi**? Siz ishlaysiz. → Siz ishlaysiz**mi**? Ingliz tilida «-mi» yo'q — uning vazifasini **so'z tartibi** bajaradi: yordamchi fe'l egadan **oldinga** o'tadi. She **is** at home. → **Is she** at home? They **have** finished. → **Have they** finished? O'zbekchada savol belgisi gap oxirida, inglizchada esa gap boshida turadi.

Nega bu muhim? Tinglovchi birinchi so'zdanoq gap savol ekanini biladi. «You are ready?» kabi tartib odatiy savol hisoblanmaydi — u hayrat bilan qayta so'rashdek eshitiladi («Siz tayyormisiz-a?»). Odatiy savolda tartib doim bir xil: **yordamchi fe'l + ega + asosiy fe'l**.
Present Simple va Past Simple: do / does / did

Darak gapda yordamchi fe'l ko'rinmasa (I **work**, she **likes**, they **went**), savolda uning o'rniga **do / does / did** egadan oldin keladi. Asosiy fe'l asosiy shaklga qaytadi — xuddi inkordagidek (→ 43-dars): She like**s** tea. → **Does** she **like** tea? They **went** home. → **Did** they **go** home? Batafsil — → 7-dars va 12-dars.

items.text: **Did** you see the news last night?

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari (o'zbekcha tartibni saqlab qolish): «You are ready?» → **Are you ready?**; «Where you live?» → **Where do you live?**; «What time the film starts?» → **What time does the film start?**; «Does she works?» → **Does she work?**; «Did you went?» → **Did you go?**
Savol so'zlari: Where, When, Why, How ...

O'zbekchada savol so'zi javob turadigan joyda qoladi: «Siz **qayerda** yashaysiz?» Inglizchada savol so'zi doim **gap boshida**, undan keyin esa xuddi -mi savolidagidek tartib: **savol so'zi + yordamchi fe'l + ega + asosiy fe'l**. Where **do you** live? When **did** the film start? How long **have you** been here? What **is** she doing?

items.text: How often **do** the buses run on Sundays?

blocks.text: Inkor savollar: Why isn't ...? Don't you ...?

Inkor savolda `n't` yordamchi fe'lga yopishib, u bilan birga egadan oldin keladi: Why **isn't** he here? Why **didn't** you call me? **Don't** you like it? To'liq shakl (Why **did you not** call?) juda rasmiy va kam ishlatiladi. Inkor savollar uch xil vazifada keladi: 1) sabab so'rash — Why **isn't** the shop open? («Nega ... emas?»); 2) hayrat yoki tasdiq kutish — **Don't** you remember me? **Isn't** it beautiful? («... -mi?», «... emasmi?»); 3) taklif — **Why don't we** take a taxi? («... -sak-chi?»).

items.text: Why **didn't** you come to the party? We missed you.
**Don't** you remember me? We were at school together!
items.translation: Meni **eslay olmayapsizmi**? Biz bir maktabda o'qiganmiz-ku!

items.text: Why **don't** we meet at the café near the station?

blocks.text: Inkor savolga javob ham faktga qarab beriladi (→ 41-dars): Don't you like coffee? — **No, I don't.** (= Ha, yoqtirmayman) / **Yes, I do.** (= Yo'q, yoqtiraman).

Eslab qolish: savol — darak gapning «aylantirilgani». Ega va yordamchi fe'l o'rin almashadi; yordamchi fe'l yo'q bo'lsa — **do / does / did** chaqiriladi. O'zbekcha **-mi** = inglizcha yordamchi fe'l gap boshida.

Istisnolar keyingi darslarda: savol so'zi o'zi ega bo'lsa (Who saw you? What happened?) do / did ishlatilmaydi — → 45-dars; predlog bilan tugaydigan savollar (Who are you talking to?) — → 46-dars; bilvosita savolda (Do you know where she lives?) tartib yana darak gapdagidek — → 49-dars.

items: Savol: **yordamchi fe'l + ega + asosiy fe'l** — Is she ...? Have you ...? Can Tom ...?
Yordamchi fe'l bo'lmasa: **Do / Does / Did** + ega + asosiy shakl — Does he **work**? Did they **go**?
Savol so'zi doim boshida: **Where do** you live? **How long have** you been here?
Inkor savol: **Why isn't** ...? **Why didn't** you ...? **Don't** you ...?

examples.title: Questions with **be**: **Is she** ...? **Were you** ...?
examples.description: **be** bilan savol: am / is / are / was / were egadan oldinga o'tadi. Present Continuous, going to va majhul nisbatda ham shunday: **Are** the children playing? **Was** it built ...?

sentences.text: **Is** Madina at home? — No, she's at the library.
**Are** your parents from Tashkent too?
**Was** the exam difficult? — Not really, it was quite easy.
sentences.translation: Imtihon **qiyin bo'ldimi**? — Unchalik emas, ancha oson edi.

sentences.text: Excuse me, **is** this seat free?
**Were** you at work when the accident happened?
**Is** it going to rain this afternoon?
**Are** the children still playing in the garden?
Tom, **are** you listening to me? — Sorry, what did you say?
**Was** the museum built before the war? — Yes, in 1910.
**Is** Bekzod's new flat near the centre, or is it far away?
sentences.translation: Bekzodning yangi kvartirasi markazga **yaqinmi** yoki uzoqdami?

examples.title: **Do you** ...? **Does he** ...? **Did they** ...?
examples.description: Present Simple va Past Simple savoli: **Do / Does / Did** + ega + fe'lning asosiy shakli. Asosiy fe'lda `-s` ham, `-ed` ham bo'lmaydi.

sentences.text: **Do** you speak any other languages? — Yes, Russian and a little Turkish.
sentences.translation: Boshqa tillarda **gapirasizmi**? — Ha, ruscha va ozgina turkcha.

sentences.text: **Does** Aziz know about the party? — No, it's a surprise!
sentences.translation: Aziz ziyofat haqida **biladimi**? — Yo'q, bu kutilmagan sovg'a!

sentences.text: **Did** you enjoy your holiday in Turkey?
**Does** this train stop at Oxford?
**Did** Emma pass her driving test? — Yes, at the first attempt.
sentences.translation: Emma haydovchilik imtihonidan **o'tdimi**? — Ha, birinchi urinishdayoq.

sentences.text: **Do** your children go to school by bus?
Sarah, **did** you remember to buy milk?
**Does** it cost much to fly to London from Tashkent?
**Did** the shop give you your money back?
**Do** Madina and Bekzod still live in Samarkand?
sentences.translation: Madina bilan Bekzod hali ham Samarqandda **yashashadimi**?

examples.title: **Have you** ...? **Can she** ...? **Will they** ...?
examples.description: have / has (Present Perfect), can, could, will, should, would bilan savol: shu fe'l egadan oldinga chiqadi, do kerak emas.

sentences.text: **Have** you ever been to Scotland?
**Can** your brother come and help us on Saturday?
sentences.translation: Akangiz shanba kuni kelib bizga **yordam bera oladimi**?

sentences.text: **Will** the shops be open on New Year's Day?
**Has** Madina told you the news? — No, what news?
sentences.translation: Madina sizga yangilikni **aytdimi**? — Yo'q, qanaqa yangilik?

sentences.text: **Should** I bring anything to the dinner? — No, just come!
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqatga biror narsa **olib kelaymi**? — Yo'q, o'zingiz kelsangiz bas!

sentences.text: **Could** you repeat the address more slowly, please?
**Have** the children had their lunch yet?
**Would** you like some more tea?
**Can** we park here, or is it only for residents?
sentences.translation: Bu yerda mashina **qo'ysak bo'ladimi** yoki bu joy faqat shu yerda yashovchilar uchunmi?

sentences.text: **Will** Tom be at the airport to meet us? — I think so.
sentences.translation: Tom bizni kutib olish uchun aeroportda **bo'ladimi**? — Shunday deb o'ylayman.

examples.title: **Where is** ...? **How long have you** ...?
examples.description: Savol so'zi doim gap boshida, keyin yordamchi fe'l, keyin ega: Where **is** the station? What **are** you cooking? How long **have** you lived here?

sentences.text: **Where is** the nearest cash machine?
**What are** you cooking? It smells wonderful!
**Why was** Bekzod so angry yesterday?
**How long have** you lived in Manchester?
**When will** the new metro station open?
**Where were** you at eight o'clock last night? — At home, watching TV.
sentences.translation: Kecha soat sakkizda **qayerda edingiz**? — Uyda edim, televizor ko'rayotgandim.

sentences.text: **What time can** I check in? — From two o'clock.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonaga **soat nechadan** joylashsam bo'ladi? — Soat ikkidan.

sentences.text: **How many** countries **has** Sarah visited?
**Which** bus **should** I take to get to the old city?
sentences.translation: Eski shaharga borish uchun **qaysi** avtobusga o'tirishim kerak?

sentences.text: **How is** your grandmother? Is she feeling better now?
sentences.translation: Buvingiz **qalaylar**? Hozir o'zlarini yaxshiroq his qilyaptilarmi?

examples.title: **Where do** you ...? **What time did** ...?
examples.description: Present Simple va Past Simple da savol so'zidan keyin **do / does / did**, asosiy fe'l asosiy shaklda: Where **do** you **buy** ...? What **did** the mechanic **say**?

sentences.text: **Where do** you usually buy your bread?
**What time does** the last bus leave?
**How did** you meet your husband?
**Why does** Madina always arrive late?
**What did** the mechanic say about your car?
**How often do** you go swimming in winter?
**When did** Tom and Emma get married?
**How much did** your new laptop cost?
**Where did** you learn to cook such delicious plov?
**What do** people in Britain usually eat for breakfast?

examples.title: Negative questions: **Why isn't** ...? **Didn't** ...?
examples.description: Inkor savol: (savol so'zi +) yordamchi fe'l + `n't` + ega. **Why isn't / Why didn't** — sabab so'rash, **Isn't it ...? / Didn't she ...?** — hayrat yoki tasdiq kutish.

sentences.text: **Why isn't** Bekzod at work today? Is he ill?
I called you five times! **Why didn't** you answer?
sentences.translation: Sizga besh marta qo'ng'iroq qildim! Nega **javob bermadingiz**?

sentences.text: It's after ten. **Why aren't** the children in bed?
sentences.translation: Soat o'ndan o'tdi. Nega bolalar hali **yotishmadi**?

sentences.text: **Why doesn't** Madina like flying? — She's afraid of heights.
sentences.translation: Madina nega samolyotda uchishni **yoqtirmaydi**? — U balandlikdan qo'rqadi.

sentences.text: Half the team is on holiday. **Why wasn't** the meeting cancelled?
sentences.translation: Jamoaning yarmi ta'tilda. Nega yig'ilish **bekor qilinmadi**?

sentences.text: **Haven't** you started your homework yet? It's nearly nine!
sentences.translation: Hali uy vazifangizni **boshlamadingizmi**? Soat to'qqiz bo'lay deb qoldi!

sentences.text: **Isn't** it a beautiful view? I could stay here all day.
sentences.translation: Manzara **ajoyib emasmi**? Bu yerda kun bo'yi qolsam ham bo'lardi.

sentences.text: Mum, **why can't** we go to the beach tomorrow? — Because it's going to rain.
sentences.translation: Oyi, nega ertaga plyajga **bora olmaymiz**? — Chunki yomg'ir yog'adi.

sentences.text: **Didn't** Sarah tell you? She's moving to Oxford next month.
sentences.translation: Sara sizga **aytmadimi**? U kelasi oy Oksfordga ko'chib ketyapti.

sentences.text: **Why won't** the car start? I filled it up with petrol this morning!
sentences.translation: Nega mashina **o't olmayapti**? Bugun ertalab benzin quygandim-ku!

examples.title: **Don't you** ...? **Why don't we** ...?
examples.description: **Don't you ...? / Aren't you ...?** — hayrat yoki tasdiq kutish («Yoqmadimi?», «... emasmisiz?»). **Why don't we / you ...?** — taklif: «... -sak-chi?», «... -sangiz-chi?»

sentences.text: **Don't** you like the soup? You haven't eaten anything.
**Aren't** you Aziz's sister? We met at his wedding.
sentences.translation: Siz Azizning singlisi **emasmisiz**? Uning to'yida tanishgan edik.

sentences.text: **Why don't we** have a picnic in the park on Sunday?
You look tired. **Why don't you** go to bed early tonight?
**Can't** you see I'm busy? Please come back later.
**Doesn't** Tom work at the hospital? Maybe he can help.
sentences.translation: Tom shifoxonada **ishlamaydimi**? Balki u yordam bera olar.

sentences.text: **Haven't** we met before? Your face looks familiar.
Bored? **Why don't you** call Dilnoza and go to the cinema?
**Wasn't** the concert great? I loved every song!
sentences.translation: Konsert **zo'r emasmidi**? Har bir qo'shig'i yoqdi!

sentences.text: It's such a lovely evening. **Why don't we** walk home instead of taking a taxi?
sentences.translation: Qanday ajoyib oqshom. Taksi o'rniga uyga **piyoda borsak-chi**?

examples.title: Dialogue: a job interview
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ishga qabul suhbati. Turli savollar — do / did bilan, be, can, will bilan, savol so'zli va inkor savol.

sentences.text: — Good morning, Ms Karimova. **Did you find** our office easily?
sentences.translation: — Xayrli tong, Karimova xonim. Ofisimizni oson **topdingizmi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, **I did**, thank you. I came by metro.
— Good. So, **where do you work** at the moment?
— At a travel company in Tashkent. **I've been** there for three years.
sentences.translation: — Toshkentdagi turistik kompaniyada. U yerda uch **yildan beri ishlayman**.

sentences.text: — I see. **Why do you want** to leave?
— **I'd like** a new challenge, and I want to use my English more.
sentences.translation: — Yangi sinovlarni **xohlayman**, ingliz tilimni ham ko'proq ishlatmoqchiman.

sentences.text: — **Can you speak** any other languages?
— Yes, Russian and a little German. **Is** that important for this job?
sentences.translation: — Ha, ruscha va ozgina nemischa. Bu ish uchun bu **muhimmi**?

sentences.text: — Quite important. **Didn't you see** it in the job advert? We have many German clients.
sentences.translation: — Ancha muhim. E'londa **ko'rmadingizmi**? Bizning nemis mijozlarimiz ko'p.

sentences.text: — Oh, I see. **When will you tell** me your decision?
